test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An area where fruit trees are grown
solution:
The correct answer is **" An area where fruit trees are grown is an orchard".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In an orchard, fruit trees are grown on land.
 
• These comprise nut-producing trees.
 
• **Example - ***An apple orchard.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• * The field*** **is land used for growing crops surrounded by walls or fences.
 
• **A Garden **is a piece of land near a house where flowers and vegetables can be grown.
 
• **The farm **is used for growing crops or keeping animals.
